title: docs(types,changeset): point three objectui#9621 prose sites at their instrument instead of at a remembered answer
body:
Fixes #9629

Clause-②: no — nothing here relaxes an accepted set or enlarges a public surface. Three prose sites, plus the removal of one test row that is redundantly pinned elsewhere. No published face moves in either direction, and no assertion of either retirement pin was weakened.

The isolated at-tier contract review of objectui#9621 (VERDICT **PASS**) named these three as non-blocking. That verdict is adopted verbatim and is not reopened here: none of the three is a contract defect. This corrects prose the review was right to let pass.

---

## 1. The docblock stopped writing the instrument's answer down

`ObjectKanbanSchema.allowCollapse`'s tombstone docblock recorded per-key control counts in prose. `AGENTS.md` #9 asks a claim like that to point at the instrument and never write down its answer.

⛔ **Not repaired by writing today's number in place of the stale one.** The paragraph now names the control keys without their counts, and names the walk that derives them: the `it` called "`@object-ui/plugin-kanban` names it in ZERO files, with controls firing in the same pass", in `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-kanban-allow-collapse-retired-8801.test.ts`.

**One cardinal survives on purpose, and here is the reasoning the card asked for.** The word ZERO stays. It is not a remembered reading: it is that test's own assertion, `expect(counts.get(RETIRED)).toBe(0)`, re-derived on every test run. The four control counts were the opposite — derived once, re-derived never, and already drifted when they landed. So the rule is applied by keeping the figure a live instrument asserts and dropping the four it does not.

## 2. The suite title — route **(b)**, and the reading that decided it

Route (b) was open, so route (b) was taken: the restating refusal row is **dropped**, and the title now states the claim the suite measures. Each pin asserts in one place.

**What had to be shown first**, per the dispatch: that the refusal the dropped row asserts is pinned by symbol in `object-kanban-allow-collapse-retired-8801.test.ts`, with a lit control on the same instrument. A one-off ablation answered it — the mirror's tombstone key was renamed on disk, the two pin files were run, and the tree was restored.

```
HEAD blob of packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts = 492cbebe7d40ad01c0780a3b61cb446ce64462ea
BEFORE  original-anchor=1  mutated-anchor=0
AFTER   original-anchor=0  mutated-anchor=1
mutated blob = bd04e4010babd47e5be49dd8ec81b99849373ce2     <- differs from HEAD: the mutation reached disk
ABLATION_RUN_EXIT=1
restored blob = 492cbebe7d40ad01c0780a3b61cb446ce64462ea    <- equals HEAD blob
RESTORED: blob matches HEAD and 'git diff HEAD' is empty
```

Under that one mutation, `Tests 7 failed | 24 passed (31)`, and the failures fall this way:

| assertion | verdict under the ablation |
|---|---|
| 8802 suite 3 — `REFUSES allowCollapse` (the row dropped here) | RED |
| 8801 — `refuses the value %p at the key's OWN path, with the prescription` (x3) | RED |
| 8801 — `reports invalid_type, the code a bare z.never() arm reports` | RED |
| 8801 — `ONE string, BOTH author-facing channels` | RED |
| 8801 — `the member is still DECLARED — a tombstone, not a deletion` | RED |
| **LIT CONTROL** 8801 — `the bare node is accepted, so the instrument still says yes` | GREEN |
| **LIT CONTROL** 8801 — `a never-declared neighbour is ACCEPTED, because this arm is not strict` | GREEN |

⇒ the dropped row and the 8801 rows are the **same claim on the same instrument**, and the 8801 pin asserts strictly more of it (the message, the `invalid_type` code, the `.describe()` channel). The lit controls staying green is what makes those reds a reading rather than a validator that had started refusing everything. No coverage is lost by the drop.

A comment stands where the row was, recording why `allowCollapse` is absent from that suite and where its refusal now lives, so it is not restored in either direction. The file's docblock carried the same claim unqualified one screen above the title; it is qualified to match, since leaving two spellings of one claim in one file is the defect this card is about.

## 3. The changeset enumeration — measured, then written as places rather than counts

The occurrence set was re-measured over **every tracked file**, whole-content and whitespace-tolerant, because `git grep` is line-anchored and the name wraps mid-word in prose that folds near 80 columns.

```
corpus: tracked files = 7912 | scanned = 7827 | skipped(binary/unreadable) = 85

TARGET          allowCollapse           10 files, 39 hits
LIT CONTROL     groupBy                228 files, 1252 hits     <- fires
ABSENT CONTROL  allowCollapsify9629      0 files, 0 hits        <- a minted token, same instrument, same corpus
```

The absent control reading 0 while the lit control reads 1252 is what makes the target set a reading. The omission the card names is confirmed: `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` names the key in a comment recording that the deleted `retiredZeroReadKanbanKey` helper once carried the spelling on the sibling arm. It was in none of the enumeration's categories.

The paragraph now **names where each occurrence is** rather than counting them, carries the date the scan was taken, and points the ZERO-files walk at the pin instead of repeating its four numbers — because that body publishes verbatim into a CHANGELOG at an unknown future date, where a figure is frozen forever.

⚠️ **Caught by reading, not by a gate.** The first draft of the corrected enumeration was **born false**: this PR's own new changeset also names the key, which the after-scan found as a tenth file. `check-changeset-claims` states in its own header that born-false is exactly the shape it cannot see. The enumeration now covers it.

### Frontmatter is untouched — `check-changeset-overwrite` case 2

```
frontmatter bytes (base) : 34        frontmatter bytes (head) : 34
FRONTMATTER  base=77df8c6240b5a4008275a79ab32c148183e7fe10
FRONTMATTER  head=77df8c6240b5a4008275a79ab32c148183e7fe10   -> BYTE-IDENTICAL
WHOLE FILE   base=f897016a3f60430e38d8d9bceef06b50715949f7
WHOLE FILE   head=39413d0b60db8eadafbd2c9b7e3d94bd95a23d33   -> LIT CONTROL: differs, so the hasher is live
```

---

## A count is invariant under quotation — both positions, reported

This repair **cites** two test names that also exist in assertion position, so a naive phrase probe would read the citations as the assertions multiplying. Each phrase was counted in its assertion position separately from every other position, on both refs.

⚠️ The first probe written for this was itself **line-anchored** and read 0 quoted hits for phrases this PR wraps across lines — the same blindness the card names for residual 3. It was re-drawn whole-content before the numbers below were taken.

| phrase | BASE assert / quoted | HEAD assert / quoted |
|---|---|---|
| `keeps every verdict it had` (old title, retired) | 1 / 0 | 0 / 0 |
| `moved NO verdict on the SIBLING` (new title) | 0 / 0 | 1 / 0 |
| `refuses the value %p at the key's OWN path, with the prescription` | 1 / 0 | 1 / 1 |
| `names it in ZERO files, with controls firing in the same pass` | 1 / 0 | 1 / 3 |
| `(45 files)` (retired figure) | 0 / 1 | 0 / 0 |
| `one pin, one docs row and two historical changesets` (retired enumeration) | 0 / 1 | 0 / 0 |

**Assertion-position counts are invariant at 1 for both cited pins** — no assertion multiplied and none was removed; only quoted position rose. Neither retired figure is quoted back anywhere, so nothing stale is re-published. No row read zero on both refs, so every row measured something.

---

## Serial constraint — re-taken, and it found a row

Re-enumerated immediately before the first write, across all 13 open PRs and the 40 most recently pushed `claude/*` branches, each intersected against this card's four paths at **file** level.

Only **open draft PR objectui#9540** (card objectui#9309, `pm:blocked`, head frozen at `3e60765fb` since 2026-09-15) intersects, on `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`. Open PR objectui#8941 (`claude/pr-7058-…`, card closed) touches the same file at its line 481. Neither had moved since before claim time, so nothing widened. The seat confirmed the row independently and ruled the fence holds at **region** granularity:

- `ObjectKanbanSchema` opens at :3385; this change is confined to its `allowCollapse` docblock
- objectui#9540's region begins at `ObjectGallerySchema`, :4358 — **534 lines below**

`git diff` reports this PR's single hunk in that file as `@@ -3823,6 +3823,20 @@ export interface ObjectKanbanSchema extends BaseSchema {`. Nothing at or below :4358 is touched.

## Gates and tests

| check | exit | reading |
|---|---|---|
| `check-changeset-presence` | 0 | 1 changeset added, EMPTY frontmatter — the explicit no-release declaration |
| `check-changeset-overwrite` | 0 | report-only; the one modified changeset is documented case 2, frontmatter proven identical above |
| `check:changeset-claims` | 0 | report-only; 15 pending changesets name `objectql.ts`. Each was read — none restates anything this diff moved |
| `check:pending-changeset-literals` | 0 | |
| `check-changeset-no-major` | 0 | |
| `check-changeset-fixed` | 0 | |
| `check:control-bytes` | 0 | scanned 7827 tracked text files |
| `check:new-line-citations` | 0 | 0 cross-file line-address citations added by this branch |
| `check-governed-queue-guard` (`--self-test`) | 0 | lives at `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` in this repo |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` | 0 | includes `tsconfig.test.json`, so both pins' compile-time assertions are checked |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` | 0 | **Test Files 203 passed (203) · Tests 4761 passed (4761)** |
| `eslint --no-inline-config` on the two changed sources | 0 | 0 errors; 33 pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warnings, none on a touched line |

Every exit code was captured to disk before any pipe. A self-scan of the four changed files for control bytes read 0 — validated by a lit control (a vertical tab fires the same probe) and an absent control (a tab, deliberately outside the class, does not). The first lit control chosen for that probe was a tab and read 0, which would have made two zeros on one instrument; it was re-drawn rather than reported.

Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the rest of the farm are CI's run, not claimed here.

## Out of scope, confirmed and not edited

`content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` names the key in one row that now reads stale: it says `@object-ui/types` "still declares **both** on its mirror of this face", which objectui#9621's tombstone made false for `allowCollapse`. Named in objectui#9621's own acceptance notes as stale and outside this card's surface, so it is reported rather than touched. Dedupe words: `schema-reference` · `allowCollapse` · `quickAdd` · stale docs row · object-kanban mirror declares.

## Not touched, deliberately

The retirement itself, both published faces, and every assertion in both pins. The tombstone message, including the "lane" precision point the review raised — changing it would change what the published refusal says to an author, which is contract surface. Release PR objectui#5400. `objectui#9628`, which has landed.
